measure: Index of online job adverts. Not a vacancy count.
primary_provider: Office for National Statistics, online job advert estimates

providers.provider: Office for National Statistics, online job advert estimates

providers.reason: Adzuna job search API needs an API credential in ADZUNA_APP_KEY. No key is configured, so nothing from this provider is published. Register at https://developer.adzuna.com/.
DWP Find a Job needs an API credential in DWP_FIND_A_JOB_KEY. No key is configured, so nothing from this provider is published. Register at https://findajob.dwp.gov.uk/apidocs.

family_reasons.Pharma, Biotech R&D & Manufacturing: Industrial R&D and manufacturing science posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.
family_reasons.Healthcare Science & Diagnostics: Healthcare science posts are advertised through healthcare channels rather than general science ones.
family_reasons.Allied Health & Clinical Practice: Registered allied health posts are advertised as healthcare.
family_reasons.Leadership, Education, Operations & Cons: The family is defined by management and consulting responsibility.
family_reasons.Medicine & Dentistry: Medical and dental posts are advertised as healthcare.
family_reasons.Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Acce: Medical affairs, market access and communications posts sit with commercial and communications advertising rather than with laboratory science.
family_reasons.Research & Academia: Research posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.
family_reasons.Quality, Regulatory, Safety & Compliance: Quality assurance and regulatory affairs are the QA half of the Scientific / QA category.
family_reasons.Digital Health, Data, Informatics & AI: Health informatics and data posts are advertised as IT and software roles.
family_reasons.Nursing, Midwifery & Pharmacy: Nursing, midwifery and pharmacy posts are advertised as healthcare.
family_reasons.Clinical Research & Trials: Trial coordination, monitoring and management are advertised under Scientific / QA.
family_reasons.Medical Devices, MedTech & Engineering: Device and biomedical engineering posts are advertised as engineering.
family_reasons.Public Health, Epidemiology & Health Pol: Public health posts are advertised through healthcare and public sector channels.
family_reasons.Laboratory, Pathology & Technical Operat: Laboratory and technical operations posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.
family_reasons.Environmental & One Health: Environmental and veterinary public health science posts are advertised as scientific roles.
family_reasons.Cell & Gene Therapy, Omics & Advanced Bi: Advanced biology and omics posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.

limits: Advert categories are broad and commercially defined. Healthcare and Social care covers everything from consultant posts to care work, so the signal describes the hiring climate around a family rather than demand for one job title. Helix says so wherever the figure appears.
Advert categories are broad, so a signal describes the hiring climate around a career family rather than demand for one job title.
This source publishes an index rather than a count, so Helix shows no vacancy numbers.
This source is UK-wide, so Helix shows no regional demand.

healthcare-and-social-care.trend_window: the last four weeks against the previous twelve
healthcare-and-social-care.source: Office for National Statistics, online job advert estimates
notes: Weekly index of online job adverts, 2024. February 2020 = 100.
ONS publishes these as experimental statistics.
This is an index of advert volume, not a count of vacancies, and Helix does not convert it into one.
Published for the United Kingdom as a whole. This source does not break demand down by region.
ONS last released this series on 2024-10-24. It describes the period it covers, not the market today, and its signal strength is capped accordingly.
